basic_info.description: Stunning mid-century modern home nestled in a private Forest Knolls cul-de-sac with lush surroundings and view of Sutro Tower. The main level features 3 bedrooms, 2 remodeled baths (one en-suite), a spacious living and dining area, and a sleek, updated kitchen. The lower level includes a large family room or 4th bedroom that opens to a generous backyard perfect for indoor-outdoor living. Upgrades include dual-pane windows, Nest thermostat, Yale smart lock, and 2-car side-by-side garage with Tesla charger. Quiet and private, yet centrally located with easy access to transit, Midtown Terrace playground, and nearby hiking trails. A perfect blend of style, comfort, and convenience.
